AlgorithmInfo.description: Identifies the algorithm that produced a result, for traceability.
AlgorithmInfo.title: AlgorithmInfo

DataQuality.description:
Quality assessment of one measurement or of a window of measurements.

Data quality describes the data, not the crew member: it says how far the values
can be trusted and carries no physiological meaning. The physiological status is
reported separately, by `EvaluationStatus`.

The rules that assign `status`, `score` and `flags` belong to the data-quality
algorithm and are not part of this contract.

score.description: Overall quality from 0 (worst) to 1 (best). Null when no score is computed.
score.title: Score

completeness.description: Fraction of the expected samples that are present. Null when not applicable.
completeness.title: Completeness

algorithm.description: Algorithm that produced the assessment. Null when not assessed.

assessed_at.description: When the assessment was produced (UTC). Null when not assessed.
assessed_at.title: Assessed At

DataQuality.title: DataQuality

MeasurementSource.description:
Where a measurement comes from.

`simulated` marks synthetic data and must be used for every generated value.
MeasurementSource.title: MeasurementSource

MetricType.description: Physiological metrics that can be measured, baselined and evaluated.
MetricType.title: MetricType

QualityFlag.description:
Specific issues found while assessing data quality.

`out_of_sensor_range` refers to the measuring range documented for the device.
It is a property of the sensor, not a clinical threshold.
QualityFlag.title: QualityFlag

QualityStatus.description:
Overall usability of the assessed data. It is not a health status.

`not_assessed` means no quality algorithm has processed the data yet.
QualityStatus.title: QualityStatus

description:
A single value of one metric for one crew member.

A measurement is either instantaneous (`interval_end` is null) or aggregated over
the interval from `measured_at` to `interval_end`, as for a night of sleep.

measurement_id.description: Unique identifier, generated by the producer of the measurement.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

crew_member_id.description: Crew member the measurement refers to.
crew_member_id.title: Crew Member Id

unit.description: Unit of `value`. Must be the canonical unit of `metric` (metric_catalog.json).
unit.title: Unit

measured_at.description: Instant of the sample, or start of the observation interval (UTC).
measured_at.title: Measured At

interval_end.description: End of the observation interval (UTC). Null for instantaneous samples.
interval_end.title: Interval End

device_id.description: Identifier of the producing device, when there is one.
device_id.title: Device Id

data_quality.description: Quality assessment attached by the backend. Null or omitted on ingestion.
